news.title: Hormuz Tanker Traffic Rises This Month Even as Attacks Increase
news.summary: Tanker traffic through the Strait of Hormuz has risen this month, according to data from Vortexa, even as attacks on vessels in the contested waterway have increased.

news.title: Crew Member Dies After Diesel Tanker Capsizes Off Ibiza, No Pollution So Far
news.summary: At least one crew member aboard a ship carrying diesel has died after the vessel capsized and partially sank off the Spanish island of Ibiza on Thursday, regional authorities said, adding there were no signs of pollution so far.

news.title: PIL and Qingdao Port complete China’s first Liquefied Bio-Methane bunkering operation
news.summary: Pacific International Lines (PIL) and Qingdao Port Group have marked a significant milestone in maritime decarbonisation with China’s first LBM bunkering operation for international shipping. news.title: Most Large Fuel Tankers Now Ship ‘Dirty’ Crude, Upending Trading
news.summary: A record three-quarters of the global fleet of large tankers designed to transport oil products are tapping higher earnings to ship crude, keeping the cost to move fuels elevated.
